name: Desmond Trannore Bridge
facts: The 482‑metre Desmond Trannore Bridge rises 5 metres above the former Mulgrave River Bridge, boosting flood immunity for the Bruce Highway during wet seasons.
Construction was accelerated by installing 50 precast concrete girders, a key strategy in Australia’s flood‑proofing push for all‑year access to Far North Queensland.
Named for Senior Constable Desmond Trannore, the bridge honours the officer who was tragically shot in the line of duty on 27 October 1964 while aiding a domestic‑violence victim.
